protocol.initialization: from scratch; parent files supply configuration/provenance, not weights
protocol.comparison_scope: development under the frozen v5 scoring contract; not a final causal benchmark
protocol.post_selection_audit: repeat frozen-model observed-prefix decoding sensitivity before interpretation
protocol.sampling_scope: training windows only; validation/test order, population and scoring unchanged
protocol.interpretation: Weighted replacement changes all tasks' training exposure, not just event loss. Epoch draw count is fixed; unique windows seen can differ. No new independent data.
